governing_document: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) Building Bye-Laws & Karnataka ECBC
authority: Urban Development Department, Govt of Karnataka
climate_adaptations: Moderate plateau climate standards for South Karnataka and semi-arid provisions for North Karnataka (Kalaburagi/Belagavi).
Mandatory solar photovoltaic provision for new institutional structures.

rules.description: Continuous roof overhang of minimum 0.60m required on all exposed eaves to shield against monsoon rains.
rules.remediation: Extend roof eaves by at least 0.60m.
